conflicts.permit: We may disclose your information to service providers involved in operating the Vimeo OTT Service. This includes payment providers, email service providers, content delivery networks, cloud storage providers, analytics companies, and professionals such as accountants and lawyers.
conflicts.prohibit: This information is collected directly by our payment vendors and is not received or stored by Vimeo or any Producer.
conflicts.situation: A user provides payment card information to Vimeo's service providers when purchasing a subscription or signing up for a trial through Vimeo OTT.
conflicts.reason: One clause states Vimeo discloses user information to payment providers, while another states payment info is collected directly by payment vendors and never received by Vimeo.
